dict.string: ScCode needs access to read and edit your code files.
ScCode needs access to read and edit code files on your Desktop.
ScCode needs access to read and edit code files in your Downloads folder.
ScCode uses file presence to track code changes.
ScCode uses Apple Events to automate editor workflows.
ScCode needs access to read and edit code on removable volumes.
ScCode needs access to read and edit code on network volumes.
